title: Practice automated-assessment policy
description: Author-defined evidence Hephaestus needs before it may assess reviewed work against one practice revision.

sourceContractVersion.title: Source contract version
sourceContractVersion.description: Exact version that defines the available evidence sources and their states.

evidenceProfile.title: Evidence profile
evidenceProfile.description: Set of evidence sources allowed for this type of reviewed work.

automatedAssessment.title: Automated assessment
automatedAssessment.description: How Hephaestus may assess the practice. This author declaration does not describe or validate assessment by a developer, peer, or human mentor.

mode.title: Assessment mode
mode.description: Implementation Hephaestus uses for automated assessment.

evidenceSufficiency.title: Evidence sufficiency
evidenceSufficiency.description: Whether meeting every declared requirement is enough for Hephaestus to assess the reviewed work.

requiredEvidence.title: Required evidence
requiredEvidence.description: Every source in this list must meet its quality requirements before automated assessment may start.

optionalContext.title: Optional context
optionalContext.description: Sources that may add context but never block automated assessment when absent.

whenEvidenceIsInsufficient.title: Insufficient evidence action
whenEvidenceIsInsufficient.description: Conservative action when a required source is unavailable, incomplete, or not current.

knownLimitations.title: Known limitations
knownLimitations.description: Claims this evidence cannot support even when every requirement is met.

freshness.title: Freshness requirement
